text_post: As I write this, I’m sitting in an airport waiting for a flight. Flying always involves some obligatory down time no matter how well organized you are. Unless you can predict traffic, security lines and flight schedules with complete accuracy, you must plan to be early and wait. Because there’s no consequence to being 40 minutes early. But if you’re one minute late, your whole trip is screwed. I always like to use these times to study people. Like an emergency room, airports have an almost perfect cross section of the population, and it’s interesting (to me) to study the different approaches and reactions to the uncertainty of it. As I sit here surfing on my laptop, I hear screaming and cursing coming toward me. It’s distant, but it’s getting closer. Only one voice, male, with max’d out levels of frustration and anger. “YOU F~~~ING BITCH…!!! WHY THE HELL WOULD YOU DO SOMETHING AS F~~~ED UP AS THAT…!!! I F~~~ING HATE YOU…!!!”. Now, this is an international airport. Security is everywhere. What the hell is this? I watch and very shortly, from around the corner of the gate area, I see him. White guy, no bags, mid forties, fit, walking through the airport, screaming into a cell phone. A watch, but no wedding ring. At least 50 people at this gate waiting for a full flight. Almost everyone turns to stare. He is oblivious. His face is red. Almost purple. Veins bulging in forehead. It’s a moving drama scene with only one visible player… I know immediately it’s a woman on the other end of his phone. Men don’t get that emotional any other way. And it takes me less than a minute to sort this out: No ring, mid forties (probably divorced). No bags (He’s not flying. He’s here to pick someone up). But he’s alone (someone not on the flight). Screaming into phone, making a scene, but oblivious to it. I give it 50% chance he gets arrested by airport security. What could possibly make a man behave this way? By now, everyone reading this knows what happened: Father’s Day coming up, and he’s here to pick up his kids. But she didn’t put the kids on the flight, and she didn’t tell him… And this is the first conversation with her after the kids didn’t get off the plane. We feel for you, buddy. You stuck your dick in crazy, and now you’re paying for it. You made the payments. You paid the ransom, but you aren’t getting the hostages back, even for a visit, even on Father’s Day. And you aren’t even getting the respect of a text message to tell you that. You get to figure that out 48 hours before Father’s Day when you take the day off work to come get your kids, but they don’t get off the plane. I want to give this guy a red pill… about 15-20 years ago… I quietly hope every unmarried man in this airport sees this, and realizes this will happen to him…! MGTOW
